title: For the price its ok, and looks good.
text:
For the price its ok, and looks good.. DII Breathable, Under the Bed or Closet Soft Storage Bag with Clear Viewing Window & Zipper Closure.
I wanted this for my Granddaughter who lives here. The dresser did not hold all her things, so I thought this would work out for her.

The DII does fit under the bed, but its fragile. Its not real sturdy, and the zipper is nylon and thin.Although this is a good size.
The see threw plastic top is kind of stiff. The inside lining has a feel of a paper type of coating or material. The outside is gray feels papery also.
There is a sewed in handle on the front that is the same material as the inside lining, to pull this out.
I personally don't think this is to be pulled out everyday from under the bed or it will fall apart.
Its good to store sweaters in, or Lingerie. Mostly light in weight clothes, that are not used too often, or change
of season clothing.

The Storage bag looks nice, but I’ll see how long it holds up for.
If it holds up better then what I think, I will be back to up grade this review.

Btw when you get this , open it up and air it out.. It smells of plastic.
